# her

> An AI agent for the terminal, editors and programs. `her exec --json "TASK"` runs one task and prints one JSON result; the answer is in `final_output`.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): install, connect a model, first task
- [Scripting](scripting.md): her exec, the result object, exit codes, CI, environment variables
- [Models](models.md): every way to connect a model
- [Tools](tools.md): the tools, components, MCP servers, Skills
- [Permissions](permissions.md): modes, rules, protected paths, project trust
- [ACP](acp.md): editors
- [JSON-RPC](json-rpc.md): programs that drive her
- [Protocol reference](protocol-reference.md): every method
- [Privacy](privacy.md): every network access, what is stored
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md): her doctor, common messages
